summary: Identification criteria for 'forest' under Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980; criteria challenge: minimum area (5 hectares), crown density (40%), species composition (75% forest); Bombay High Court precedent (Shivanand Salgaocar) followed; expert committees (Sawant, Karapurkar) established; dictionary meaning vs recorded forests; open/degraded forests (10-40% canopy) inclusion dispute; criteria modification sought; NGT referral to Supreme Court; FSI definition (1 ha, 10% canopy) cited; jurisdictional continuity from Writ Petition 202/1995.
final_judgment: Appeals arising from NGT order; criteria modification sought; judgment truncated in provided text but context indicates Supreme Court addressing identification standards.
